verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents its own background automations: Scheduled Flags queue changes and apply them automatically at a future time without manual intervention, and Release Pipelines move flags through stages automatically, using triggers and actions and auto-generating change requests. The automation is limited to flag rollout workflows, and the trigger and action model is described only at a high level. Missing for 10: general-purpose or AI/agent-driven autonomous automations beyond flag scheduling and pipelines, detailed documentation of trigger and action types, independent or hands-on corroboration.
